gameMenu.featuredDesc: Many gangs. One dying world. The campaign season is live on the table.

factionsMenu.chooseDesc: Your allegiance shapes the campaign — and who you betray.

Search.hint: Type to search pages, journal reports and rules.

Hero.lead: Descend into the rust-choked underhive. Roam the endless wastes on roaring engines. Forge a gang, seize territory, and outlast rival Houses in a living war for power, survival, and control of a dying world.

Features.f1Desc: Recruit fighters, bolt on cybernetics, and scavenge the forge for gear. Every scar, weapon, and upgrade persists across the entire campaign.
Features.f2Desc: Territory shifts after every battle on the table. Campaign seasons rewrite the map, alliances rise and burn, and the spire throne is always in play.

Gangs.heading: Many gangs. One dying world. No one rules forever.

GH-01.desc: Religious fanatics fielding hordes with improvised weapons and cleansing flame. Includes the Redemptionists.

GH-02.desc: Espionage, infiltration, psychological control and mind-bending Psychoteric powers.

GH-03.desc: Speed, poisons, toxins and generations of genetic craft.

GH-04.desc: Brute strength, stimm-fuelled resilience and bio-engineered muscle.

GH-05.desc: Versatile fighters, dependable firearms and a life lived on the road.

GH-06.desc: Advanced technology, superior marksmanship and energy weaponry.

IG-01.desc: Blood-crazed cultists of Khorne devoted to savage close combat.

IG-02.desc: Necromunda's paramilitary police force, armed to keep order by any means.

IG-03.desc: Escaped ogryns risen in revolt against their former masters.

IG-04.desc: Generic Chaos cults that can represent followers of any of the Dark Gods.

IG-05.desc: Traditional Genestealer cults spreading quietly beneath the hive.

IG-06.desc: Fully customizable hunter bands — humans, Squats, Ogryns, Beastmen and Ratlings since the 2025 update.

IG-07.desc: The most open gang in the game: outlaws, mutants, wyrds, guilders, fallen nobles — almost any concept you can imagine.

AW-01.desc: Native nomads of the wastelands: stealth, ambushes, giant insects and total mastery of the terrain. Expanded through 2025.

AW-02.desc: Hardy Squat miners with industrial firepower and superb tech, heavily expanded in Halls of the Ancients.

HS-01.desc: Ultra-rich nobles in Hunting Rigs. Very few models, extremely powerful, growing through their own Terror Level mechanic.

HS-02.desc: The mutant Genestealers of Hive Secundus: hordes of Brood Scum backed by terrifying monsters, built for the Underhells.

News.empty: No reports published yet — the presses of the Underhive are warming up.
